description: Six unit squares with consistently oriented northeast diagonals; two interior vertices.

conventions.corner_order: vertex order in each oriented triangle
conventions.deformation: angle at a in (a,b,c) changes by u_b-u_c; boundary u=0
conventions.volume: sum of ideal tetrahedral volumes obtained by adjoining infinity; binary64 evaluation
conventions.boundary_voltage: x/3, independent of the angle-deformation parameter u
conventions.delaunay_scope: non-strict: each square diagonal has zero cotangent weight
conventions.certificate_scope: exact rational finite matrix/forest identities for this fixture; no strict polyhedral realization certificate
